plan.change: Phase C follow-up: make recursive scope globs newline-safe
expectedChanges: Compile recursive ** scope globs with a newline-safe expression.
Preserve single-star segment behavior while ensuring forbidden recursive patterns cannot be bypassed by newline-containing filenames.
Add regression coverage for newline-containing paths against forbidden recursive globs.
hqDecisions: This change addresses only the Codex P1 recursive-glob/newline finding from superseded PR #30.
Do not change Git path collection, Risk/Impact identity, invalid UTF-8 handling, human-readable report escaping, M1, H2, L1, Record v0.3, Phase D/E, or production.
rulesApplied: Codex P1 recursive glob newline finding
plan.manualCheckExemptionReason: Change OS glob compilation only; behavior is covered by regression tests, trusted PR gate, and later canary.
plan.rollback: Revert this staging-only remediation PR; production remains untouched.
outOfScope: M1 old Change PR Gate Plan Lock parity
H2 staging branch protection and required checks
Phase E semantic scope and concurrency controls
unverified: Post-fix unusual-path canary coverage remains required before C3-1 is formally closed.
plan.problem: Recursive ** patterns compile to dot-star, and JavaScript dot does not match newline, so a valid newline-containing Git filename can evade a forbidden recursive pattern.
plan.currentContract: globToRegExp uses .* for ** and (?:.*/)? for **/, while single-star uses [^/]*.
plan.whyExistingIsInsufficient: A path such as data/line\nname.js can fail forbiddenPaths data/** while still matching an allowed single-segment JavaScript glob, allowing Scope to PASS incorrectly.
plan.design: Compile ** with a newline-safe class such as [\s\S]* and compile **/ with an equivalent newline-safe recursive segment expression, preserving all other glob semantics.
alternativesRejected: Reject all newline-containing filenames globally; that belongs to a broader pathname policy and is outside this focused fix.
Special-case forbiddenPaths only; glob semantics should be consistent for all recursive patterns.
plan.compatibility: Existing paths without newline retain the same glob results. Single-star remains confined to one path segment.
boundaryCases: assets/**/a.png must match recursive paths even when an intermediate filename segment contains newline.
assets/*.png must remain limited to a single slash-delimited segment.
testPlan: Assert direct glob matching for ** spans newline.
Assert evaluateScope applies forbidden data/** before allowed data/*.js for a newline-containing JavaScript filename.
Run Change Operations regression suite and trusted Change PR Gate.
plan.promotionRisk: Staging Change OS only. Incorrect glob semantics could over-allow or over-block planned changes, so trusted gate review and canary are required.
